    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

(

        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,

(

        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    ProjectName,
    StartDate,

    Status AS ProjectStatus,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours

WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)

WITH CTE AS
(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)
SELECT 
    Employeekey,
    EmployeeName,
    WorkDate,
    InTime,
    OutTime,
    GrossWorkingHours,
    LunchDuration,
    BreakDuration,
    NetWorkingDuration
FROM CTE
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY WorkDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    SELECT 
        p.ProjectName,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tc.Status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AssignedTasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tc.Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OngoingTasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tc.Status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PendingTasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tc.Status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CompletedTasks
    FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
    INNER JOIN IT_Projects p ON p.ProjectKey = tc.ProjectName  -- ProjectName in TaskCreation stores ProjectKey
    WHERE

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)

ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month

    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))

),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : SELECT Gender FROM IT_EmployeeRegister WHERE EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;
Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
