    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    ProjectName,

    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

SELECT ProjectKey,
    ProjectName,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    EstimatedHours,
    Status AS ProjectStatus,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 2) AS InProgress,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status != 4) AS Pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId AND Status = 4) AS Completed,
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND ActualHours > 0 THEN ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0) END) 
            FROM IT_TaskCreation WHERE ProjectName = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeList = @UserId), 0)
    + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(AssignedHours, 0)) FROM IT_Tasktesting WHERE projectkey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND assignedto = @UserId), 0) AS UsedHours
FROM IT_Projects
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads WHERE ProjectKey = IT_Projects.ProjectKey AND EmployeeKey = @UserId)
ORDER BY StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)

        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)

WITH CTE AS
(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)

(

        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN

    WHERE 1=1
 AND MONTH(WorkDate) = @Month AND YEAR(WorkDate) = @Year
)

WITH CTE AS
(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)
SELECT 
    Employeekey,
    EmployeeName,
    WorkDate,
    InTime,
    OutTime,
    GrossWorkingHours,
    LunchDuration,
    BreakDuration,
    NetWorkingDuration
FROM CTE
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY WorkDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

WITH CTE AS
(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)
SELECT 
    Employeekey,
    EmployeeName,
    WorkDate,
    InTime,
    OutTime,
    GrossWorkingHours,
    LunchDuration,
    BreakDuration,
    NetWorkingDuration
FROM CTE
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY WorkDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,

            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey

        0

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status <> 4) AS Pending,

    -- Completed
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 4) AS Completed,

    ((SELECT SUM (CASE WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND tc.ActualHours > 0 THEN tc.ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(tc.AssignedHours,0) END) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey), 0

    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
        ),

    ISNULL

        (
            SELECT SUM

                CASE
                    WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL

                END

            FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
            WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey
              AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId
        ),
        0
    )

        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
              AND tt.assignedto = @UserId
        ),
        0
    ) AS MyLoggedHours

(

        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,

            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
        ),
        0
    ) AS TotalHoursSpent,

    -- My Logged Hours
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL
                         AND tc.ActualHours > 0
                    THEN tc.ActualHours
                    ELSE ISNULL(tc.AssignedHours,0)
                END
            )
            FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
            WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey
              AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId
        ),
        0
    )
    +
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
              AND tt.assignedto = @UserId
        ),
        0
    ) AS MyLoggedHours

FROM IT_Projects p
WHERE EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants pp
    WHERE pp.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey
      AND pp.EmployeeKey = @UserId
)
OR EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads tl
    WHERE tl.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey
      AND tl.EmployeeKey = @UserId
)
ORDER BY p.StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,

            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt

                END

        ),

        0

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status <> 4) AS Pending,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 4) AS Completed,

    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
        ),
        0

    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM

                CASE
                    WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL
                         AND tc.ActualHours > 0

                END
            )
            FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
            WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey
              AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId
        ),
        0
    )
    +
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
              AND tt.assignedto = @UserId
        ),
        0
    ) AS MyLoggedHours

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 2) AS InProgress,

    -- Pending
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status <> 4) AS Pending,

    -- Completed
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 4) AS Completed,

    -- Total Hours Spent (All Employees)
    ISNULL
    ((SELECT SUM (CASE WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND tc.ActualHours > 0 THEN tc.ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(tc.AssignedHours,0) END) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey), 0
    )
    +
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
        ),
        0
    ) AS TotalHoursSpent,

    -- My Logged Hours
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL
                         AND tc.ActualHours > 0
                    THEN tc.ActualHours
                    ELSE ISNULL(tc.AssignedHours,0)
                END
            )
            FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
            WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey
              AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId
        ),
        0
    )
    +
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
              AND tt.assignedto = @UserId
        ),
        0
    ) AS MyLoggedHours

FROM IT_Projects p
WHERE EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM IT_ProjectsParticipants pp
    WHERE pp.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey
      AND pp.EmployeeKey = @UserId
)
OR EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM IT_ProjectTeamLeads tl
    WHERE tl.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey
      AND tl.EmployeeKey = @UserId
)
ORDER BY p.StartDate DESC; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

WITH CTE AS
(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM IT_V_EmployeeDailyWorkSummary
    WHERE 1=1
 AND CAST(WorkDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)

(
    SELECT 
        Employeekey,
        EmployeeName,
        WorkDate,
        InTime,
        OutTime,
        GrossWorkingHours,
        LunchDuration,
        BreakDuration,
        NetWorkingDuration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Employeekey, CAST(WorkDate AS DATE)
            ORDER BY InTime DESC
        ) AS RN

)

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId) AS AssignedTasks,

    -- In Progress
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 2) AS InProgress,

    -- Pending
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status <> 4) AS Pending,

    -- Completed
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId AND tc.Status = 4) AS Completed,

    -- Total Hours Spent (All Employees)
    ISNULL
    ((SELECT SUM (CASE WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL AND tc.ActualHours > 0 THEN tc.ActualHours ELSE ISNULL(tc.AssignedHours,0) END) FROM IT_TaskCreation tc WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey), 0
    )
    +
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt.AssignedHours,0))
            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
        ),
        0
    ) AS TotalHoursSpent,

    -- My Logged Hours
    ISNULL
    (
        (
            SELECT SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN tc.ActualHours IS NOT NULL
                         AND tc.ActualHours > 0
                    THEN tc.ActualHours

                END
            )
            FROM IT_TaskCreation tc
            WHERE tc.ProjectName = p.ProjectKey
              AND tc.EmployeeList = @UserId
        ),
        0
    )

    ISNULL

            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt
            WHERE tt.projectkey = p.ProjectKey
              AND tt.assignedto = @UserId
        ),
        0
    ) AS MyLoggedHours

            FROM IT_Tasktesting tt

        0

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;

       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate

Severity:Information;Source:; Message:Sql : 
       ;WITH MonthDays AS
(
    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
           DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))) AS DayName
    FROM master..spt_values
    WHERE type = 'P'
      AND DATEADD(DAY, number, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)) < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
),
HolidayDates AS
(
    SELECT CAST(Holidays AS DATE) AS HolidayDate,
           Description AS HolidayName
    FROM IT_Holidays
    WHERE MONTH(Holidays) = @Month
      AND YEAR(Holidays) = @Year
),
FilteredDays AS
(
    SELECT d.TaskDate, d.DayName, h.HolidayName
    FROM MonthDays d
    LEFT JOIN HolidayDates h ON d.TaskDate = h.HolidayDate
    -- Remove the WHERE clause that was filtering out second Saturdays
),
MeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS MeetingHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND ISNULL(m.MeetingType, 0) != 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
OutsideMeetingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        mp.EmployeeKey,
        CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, m.StartTime, m.EndTime)) / 60.0 AS OutsideHours
    FROM IT_MeetingParticipants mp
    INNER JOIN IT_Meetings m ON m.MeetingKey = mp.MeetingKey
    WHERE mp.EmployeeKey = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(m.MeetingDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(m.MeetingDate) = @Year
      AND m.Status IN (1, 2)
      AND m.MeetingType = 6
    GROUP BY mp.EmployeeKey, CAST(m.MeetingDate AS DATE)
),
TaskHours AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.EndDate IS NOT NULL
                     AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
                THEN CAST(ISNULL(t.AssignedHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                     / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.StartDate, t.EndDate) + 1, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TaskHours,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS ActualTaskHours
    FROM FilteredDays d
    LEFT JOIN IT_TaskCreation t
        ON t.EmployeeList = @EmployeeKey
        AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN t.StartDate AND t.EndDate
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate
),
TestingHours AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE) AS TaskDate,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tt.ActualHours, tt.AssignedHours) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TestingHours
    FROM IT_TaskTesting tt
    WHERE tt.assignedto = @EmployeeKey
      AND MONTH(tt.StartDate) = @Month
      AND YEAR(tt.StartDate) = @Year
    GROUP BY CAST(tt.StartDate AS DATE)
),
LeaveData AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TaskDate,
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
        l.LeaveType
    FROM FilteredDays d
    INNER JOIN IT_EmployeeLeaveDetails l
        ON l.Employeekey = @EmployeeKey
       AND d.TaskDate BETWEEN CAST(l.Fromdate AS DATE) AND CAST(l.Todate AS DATE)
    WHERE ISNULL(l.Responsestatus, 0) = 2
    GROUP BY d.TaskDate, l.LeaveType
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.TaskDate, 103) AS TaskDate,
    LEFT(d.DayName, 3) AS DayName,
    ISNULL(d.HolidayName, '') AS HolidayName,
    CAST(ISNULL(m.MeetingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS MeetingsHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.TaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(t.ActualTaskHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ActualTaskHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(th.TestingHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TestingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(om.OutsideHours, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OutsideMeetingHours,
    CAST(ISNULL(l.IsLeave, 0) AS BIT) AS IsLeave,
    ISNULL(CAST(l.LeaveType AS VARCHAR(10)), '') AS LeaveType
FROM FilteredDays d
LEFT JOIN MeetingHours m ON d.TaskDate = m.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN OutsideMeetingHours om ON d.TaskDate = om.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TaskHours t ON d.TaskDate = t.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN TestingHours th ON d.TaskDate = th.TaskDate
LEFT JOIN LeaveData l ON d.TaskDate = l.TaskDate
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month >= MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year >= YEAR(GETDATE()))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN (@Month < MONTH(GETDATE()) OR (@Month = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND @Year < YEAR(GETDATE())))
        THEN CONVERT(DATE, d.TaskDate)
    END DESC;; StackTrace:; InnerException:;CustomReference:;
